clips.title: The story
paras: In Stormwind, Furen's Instructions name the materials needed for fire-hardened mail. Furen Longbeard gives the parchment to Alliance warriors he has tested.

Furen Longbeard offers to forge a resilient suit of mail for a warrior who has proved himself through simpler smithing work. The dwarven armorer asks the warrior to fetch the rare components himself. His parchment records what is needed and sends the warrior across continents to gather it.

The parchment calls for a dangerous journey through the Eastern Kingdoms and Kalimdor. The hardened links need dozens of scorched spider fangs from damp caves in the Wetlands, along with horns from fire-breathing chimaeras in the crags of Stonetalon Mountains. The list also calls for a galvanized horn from the chimaera matriarch and a vial of volatile phlogiston held deep within Razorfen Kraul, a quilboar bastion.
